flags.claim: Benji Dillon threw 150.1 innings over 35 appearances and 28 starts, going 10-8 with a 4.43 ERA. He allowed 3.9 BB/9, struck out 7.9 per nine and posted 2.03 K/BB, with 65 walks and 132 strikeouts.
flags.issue: Contradicts canonical 2041 season pitching record in ground truth (Benji Dillon was 9-8 with a 4.61 ERA, 120 strikeouts, 56 walks in 140.2 innings).

summary: Direct contradiction of Benji Dillon's canonical 2041 pitching statistics.
